integrity: All calculations and checker tests stated as performed; no human-independent certification or attribution implied. A finite checker is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Undirected loopless zero-product graph of nonzero singular 2x2 matrices; real adjacency spectrum; no claim for larger matrices, coefficient rings, directed graphs or even-modulus quaternion rings. Earlier 2021 quotient reduction supplies an implicit finite computation; the new claim is uniform explicit factorization and its sharp invariants. Independent validation not performed.
title: Complete zero-product spectrum of two-by-two finite matrix rings
